collisions.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {q : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype m] [inst_1 : Fintype q] (Q : Matrix m q ℝ)
  (A : Matrix m n ℝ), NLAlib.residual Q A = A - Q * (Q.transpose * A)
collisions.other_type: ∀ (X : Type u_5) [inst : TopologicalSpace X], residual X = Filter.countableGenerate {t | IsOpen t ∧ Dense t}

collisions.type:
{m : Type u_1} →
  {n : Type u_2} → {q : Type u_3} → [Fintype m] → [Fintype q] → Matrix m q ℝ → Matrix m n ℝ → Matrix m n ℝ
